text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before heading to Kyoto Racecourse to run 
in the Mile CS—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I believe I have done everything in my 
power. However,
if everything I did was of 
no effect at all—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ... ...Your posture is poor.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I told you before, didn't I? If you wish 
to accomplish something, you must always 
carry yourself with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You... surely have accomplished enough to 
be worthy of that.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Yes. Never forget that pride."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Let us go. After that,
all that remains... 
is to show me the results.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse was packed with countless 
spectators. The sheer excitement in the 
air rivaled even the prestigious Tenno
Sho 
(Spring) held at the same venue...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"This is your achievement.
You should hold 
your head high and accept it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All I did was spread the word... 
showcasing the runners' sheer brilliance 
and charm, letting everyone witness 
Daiichi Ruby's running. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: It's simply become the stage you n...
It's simply become your natural stage.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I feel the same way.
choice_data_list: I'm sure today will be a fantastic...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—An incredible lineup has gathered. 
Everyone has worked tirelessly for this 
day.)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! This year is... mine!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make it a totally fire race!
Get 
ready to fall head over heels for me, 
Milady☆

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ruby... I've grown stronger. I'll 
definitely surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(It was precisely because they were there 
that I was able to aim even higher.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(—And then, there was one more person. 
Someone who illuminated this path even 
further...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The stage is set. With my run and my 
victory――it shall be complete."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That light lasts but a moment. However,
it 
will surely be burned into your eyes
for a 
lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passion dwells within her sharp, 
intelligent eyes... A magnificent display 
befitting her name—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"Please gaze upon my most brilliant 
radiance."
